Map overview

▾

Construction Site North of Kerning City is a hunting ground in Victoria Road, Victoria Island in MapleStory Classic. Monsters here include Red Snail, Orange Mushroom, Dark Stump, and Octopus, and others. Monsters are around levels 4–19. There are 54 monster spawn points.

How this estimate works▾

Your estimate. Built from the kill rates you set. Supply is still the ceiling: a monster cannot beat what its spawn points regenerate on the 7.56-second server tick.

Spawn model. Uses a 7.56-second global server tick, a 5-second wave-pool cooldown, and capacity from 75% of spawn points solo to 100% with 6+ players.

Party EXP. COT2 grants +10% with two players, +20% with three, and +30% with four to six. The EXP figure above is the map's total base EXP output before party sharing or bonuses.

Monsters (6 types, 54 total spawns)

spawn rulesHow spawns work. The server runs a global 7.56s respawn tick across every loaded map. After a mob dies its spawn point waits a cooldown (5s default, or usually the WZ mobTime value for timed spawns), then the mob reappears on the next tick. Field-boss schedules are server-owned, so unconfirmed live-timing windows are labelled when they differ from the raw map value. Map capacity scales with players on the map: 75% solo, +5% per extra player, capping at 100% from 6 players. This map has 54 spawn points, so capacity is ~41 concurrent mobs solo and 54 in a full party.Mob rate (1.2x) multiplies that capacity: expect about 65 monsters up at a time. Not applied to the figures above yet; best reading from closed-beta play.

About mob rate. Mob rate multiplies how many monsters this map keeps alive at once. This map has 54 spawn points and a mob rate of 1.2x, so expect about 65 monsters up at a time instead of 54. The spawn figures above do not apply it yet. This is our best reading from closed-beta play, where a high-rate map held far more monsters than it has spawn points; an exact whole-map count has not been done.
